FU-003.reason: BaseAPI.send retries a transient failure only for GET/HEAD or when the resolved headers carry a non-empty Idempotency-Key; a timed-out POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE is no longer re-sent, so admin pay/approve and DB restore cannot be duplicated by the transport. Retries recurse in send, so a coalesced GET gets the full retry count.

FU-002.reason: GET coalescing TTL is 0 (in-flight dedupe only), so no settled response, success or failure, is reused. Every settled write (request non-GET, rawRequest non-GET/HEAD, uploadWithProgress) bumps readGeneration in the coalescing key and clears the coordinator, so a GET after a mutation always refetches.

It stays until the next read of the same key or a clear, so the last response of every distinct GET key is retained in memory (for example page-data id segments). Skip the set when ttlMs <= 0. That needs a B2 writer assignment from the orchestrator.

core/integrations/laravel/transport/BaseAPI.ts:315 (non-blocking) request() sends every non-GET method through the write branch, including HEAD, which then invalidates coalesced reads. Harmless (extra refetch only).
